::: {.lead}
Teaching and Research Fellow (ATER) at the **IUT de Villetaneuse**, Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. Researcher at **CEPN** (UR 7234) and **CEREG** (Université de Yaoundé II). My research investigates **development economics**, **entrepreneurship**, and the interplay between information technologies, energy, finance, and well-being in emerging economies.
:::

I use **mixed methods** — econometrics on macroeconomic panels, field surveys, and qualitative analysis — to inform inclusive and sustainable public policy. My main empirical settings are Sub-Saharan Africa and, more broadly, emerging economies.

## Research themes

- **Information technologies & social media** — ICT diffusion, growth, well-being, remittances, political empowerment.
- **Energy, poverty & well-being** — energy poverty, electricity access, conflicts, entrepreneurship.
- **Entrepreneurship & the informal economy** — entrepreneurial resilience, informality, institutional stability.
- **Women's empowerment & public policy** — FDI, environmental policy, political participation.
- **Growth, FDI & structural policies** — infrastructure, fiscal decentralisation, nation branding, industrialisation.
